title: Reduced primary street setback for a portion of the frontage: maximum width of the reduced portion
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: i. the primary street setback line may be reduced for a portion of the frontage width in accordance with in Table 3.3b (refer Figure 3.3a). Table 3.3b, maximum percentage of frontage width (one merged cell for R10 - R40): The greater of: 30% of the frontage width or 4m. Maximum percentage of frontage width excludes garages which are provided in accordance with Table 3.3c.

replaces.note: 30% of frontage -> the greater of 30% or 4 m

verified.note: Footnote reads 'Maximum percentage of frontage width excludes garages which are provided in accordance with Table 3.3c': a garage that meets Table 3.3c is not counted in the reduced-portion width (same reading as Chapters 2 and 3).

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.2(i)#r1. The formula value is the permitted width (the greater of 30% of the frontage width or 4 m); the rule MEETS when the built-forward width is at or under it. The Table 3.3b note excluding Table 3.3c garages from the width is ambiguous; the fact is taken as the width excluding such a garage.
